Source contracts: scripts/binary_runtime_image.py

scripts/binary_runtime_image.py

Python · Tier B

Build the private interpreter, installed dependencies and startup tools.

Usage

Called by binary_builder to stage a native, self-contained runtime image.

Inputs

Pinned CPython/Go/Bash/OpenSSL sources, tracked repository snapshot and dependency lock.

Side effects

Downloads and builds private tools, installs wheels into the staged interpreter, completes package resources, records dependency hashes and prepares relocatable files.

Cleanup

Only staged build inputs/debris are modified; the builder owns stage/cache removal.

@see scripts/binary_snapshot.py

@see docs/binary-distribution.md

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
python_executable 33 Not yet documented
prepare_toolchain 37 Not yet documented
build_native_tools 46 Build/cache private Bash and OpenSSL for supported Unix targets. Windows uses its platform tools. Pinned source changes select a new cache key; compiler output stays in builder-owned logs, and failed builds raise with that path.
complete_wheel 119 Carry the tracked package resource closure, including data omitted by package-data globs. This changes only the staged wheel and regenerates RECORD before non-editable installation.
install_python 157 Install pinned CPython plus the packaged project and record native dependencies. Stage wheel downloads and the non-editable install inside the supplied build work tree. Validate the installed dependency set and retain hashes for lock replay.
stage_python 316 Copy the installed interpreter into a clean runtime image with relocation markers. Reject links leaving the verified interpreter prefix and rewrite startup wrappers. Return paths whose embedded interpreter placeholders must be finalized on extraction.
